{
  "name": "loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Use a pairwise margin loss that blends advantage signals with log-probability gaps via a tanh activation, emphasizing margin ranking with non-linear smoothing and multiplicative weighting by advantage gap magnitude.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = lpw - lpl\nscaled_margin = alpha * margin\nadvantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\nsmooth_margin = tanh(scaled_margin)\nweight_factor = abs(advantage_gap)\nloss_per_pair = relu(1 - smooth_margin) * weight_factor * weight\nfinal_loss = mean(loss_per_pair)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin_rank_blend",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh_relu",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_weighted"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "relu",
    "abs",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)\n    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(scaled_margin)\n    weight_factor = ops.abs(advantage_gap)\n    hinge_loss = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))\n    loss = ops.mul(hinge_loss, weight_factor)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_shifted_agg",
  "intuition": "pairwise logsigmoid loss with shifted aggregation by summing weighted losses before normalization",
  "pseudocode": "losses = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap, -20, 20))\nweighted_sum = sum(losses * weight)\nnormalizer = sum(weight)\nloss = weighted_sum / normalizer",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(losses, weight))\n        weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)\n        loss = weighted_sum / ops.clamp(weight_sum, 1e-6, 1e6)\n    else:\n        loss = losses.mean()\n    return loss\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "A pairwise ranking loss that uses a smooth tanh operator on the scaled difference of log probabilities, weighted by the advantage gap, to softly encourage better ranking while penalizing margin violations in a bounded range.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = lpw - lpl\nscaled_diff = clamp(alpha * diff, -10, 10)\nsmooth_rank = tanh(scaled_diff)\nweighted_loss = (1 - smooth_rank) * advantage_gap * weight\nloss = mean(weighted_loss)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled_diff = ops.clamp(ops.mul(alpha, diff), -10.0, 10.0)\n    smooth_rank = ops.tanh(scaled_diff)\n    base_loss = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_rank), smooth_rank), advantage_gap)\n    if weight is not None:\n        base_loss = ops.mul(base_loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(base_loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_sigmoid_rank_blend_advantage",
  "intuition": "blends sigmoid ranking loss with advantage-weighted margin emphasizing pairs with higher advantage gaps, switching from logsigmoid margin to a smooth sigmoid penalty scaled by rank-based weights to emphasize more meaningful preference separations",
  "pseudocode": "adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\nadv_l = batch['advantage_l']\nadv_gap = adv_w - adv_l\nlpw = batch['log_prob_w']\nlpl = batch['log_prob_l']\ndelta = lpw - lpl\nrank_weights = normalize(rank_gap(delta))  # rank_gap returns difference in ranks of batch elements\nscaled_margin = alpha * delta\nsigmoid_loss = sigmoid(-scaled_margin) * rank_weights * ops.relu(adv_gap)\nweighted_loss = sigmoid_loss * weight\nloss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "sigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_nonneg_weighting"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sigmoid",
    "relu",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "normalize",
    "rank_gap"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    delta = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    rank_w = ops.normalize(ops.rank_gap(delta))\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, delta)\n    loss_base = ops.sigmoid(ops.neg(scaled_margin))\n    adv_relu = ops.relu(adv_gap)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(loss_base, rank_w), adv_relu)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_tanh_sum",
  "intuition": "Instead of margin-based or logsigmoid paradigm, this loss uses a saturating nonlinear transformation (tanh) to smoothly reward larger advantage gaps and penalize misrankings. It sums a nonlinear score of advantage and a normalized margin of log probabilities, combining them additively before aggregation.",
  "pseudocode": "loss = mean(weight * (relu(tanh(-advantage_gap)) + relu(tanh((log_prob_l - log_prob_w)/scale))))",
  "hyperparams": {

    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh_relu",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [

    "relu",
    "sub",

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    margin = ops.div(ops.sub(lpl, lpw), scale)\n    # Nonlinear penalties: encourage advantage_gap positive, margin negative\n    pen_adv = ops.relu(ops.tanh(ops.neg(adv_gap)))\n    pen_margin = ops.relu(ops.tanh(margin))\n    loss_values = ops.add(pen_adv, pen_margin)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_values = ops.mul(loss_values, weight)\n    return loss_values.mean()"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_tanh_blend",
  "intuition": "A pairwise loss that blends the advantage scores of winning and losing sequences modulated by a tanh link of their log probability differences, emphasizing smooth gradients and adaptive weighting of examples based on their advantage magnitude.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\nadv_l = batch['advantage_l']\ndelta_lp = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']\ntanh_lp = tanh(scale * delta_lp)\nloss_w = relu(adv_w) * (1 - tanh_lp)\nloss_l = relu(adv_l) * (1 + tanh_lp)\nloss = weight * (loss_w + loss_l)\nreturn mean(loss)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    delta_lp = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    tanh_lp = ops.tanh(ops.mul(scale, delta_lp))\n    relu_adv_w = ops.relu(adv_w)\n    relu_adv_l = ops.relu(adv_l)\n    loss_w = ops.mul(relu_adv_w, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(tanh_lp), tanh_lp))\n    loss_l = ops.mul(relu_adv_l, ops.add(ops.ones_like(tanh_lp), tanh_lp))\n    loss = ops.add(loss_w, loss_l)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "pairwise_clamped_tanh_adv_max",

Weighting by the absolute maximum advantage emphasizes pairs with higher relative importance, promoting better preference alignment.",
  "pseudocode": "lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_sigmoid_regret_weighted_logprob_gap",
  "intuition": "This loss uses a pairwise sigmoid link on the log-probability gap to softly model preference likelihood, but weights the loss by a normalized regret signal emphasizing pairs with high regret difference.   "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(delta_regret))\n    # Normalize regret weights to sum to 1 across batch to stabilize scale\n    abs_regret = ops.abs(delta_regret)\n    regret_sum = ops.sum(abs_regret)\n    # Avoid div by zero\n    regret_sum_safe = ops.add(regret_sum, ops.ones_like(regret_sum)*1e-8)\n    regret_weight = ops.div(abs_regret, regret_sum_safe)\n    logit = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    # Probability of correct ranking modeled by sigmoid(logit)\n    # Cross-entropy loss: -log(sigmoid(logit)) for winner preferred over loser\n    log_sigmoid = ops.log(ops.sigmoid(logit))\n    per_pair_loss = ops.neg(log_sigmoid)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(per_pair_loss, ops.mul(regret_weight, weight))\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
